description: This file defines the ComponentValidator class responsible for validating component definitions and properties within Drupal's theme component system, utilizing JSON schema validation.

classes.name: ComponentValidator
classes.description: A class that validates Drupal theme components against their schema definitions, ensuring proper structure and types, and handling class/interface validation for component properties.

methods.name: setValidator
methods.description: Sets the JSON schema validator service if available.

methods.name: validateDefinition
methods.description: Validates a component's definition against its schema, checking for name collisions, schema presence, property types, and class existence.

methods.name: validateProps
methods.description: Validates component properties against the schema, including class/interface validation and error reporting.

methods.name: validateClassProps
methods.description: Validates that props are instances of specified classes/interfaces and adjusts schema accordingly.

methods.name: getClassProps
methods.description: Retrieves props that are expected to be class instances based on the schema.

methods.name: nullifyClassPropsSchema
methods.description: Modifies the schema to set class-based props' types to 'null' for JSON schema validation.
